name: Temporary Residence Permit -- Employment

requirements.blocker_text: Minimum monthly salary of EUR 1,143 (2021 baseline; reviewed and generally increased each year -- a 2025 all-worker average of EUR 1,757 is reported by a separate tier-3 source, suggesting the operative current figure is materially higher than this stale baseline).

The employer must register the vacancy with the State Employment Agency (NVA); if unfilled by a domestic or EU/EEA candidate within at least 30 days, the employer's invitation for the foreign candidate may proceed to migration-authority approval.

evidence_required.document: Employment contract with a specific employer and position
Evidence the vacancy was registered with the NVA and unfilled after 30 days

outcome.duration_length: for the period of employment, up to 1 year under the New Immigration Law (effective 11 June 2026; previously up to 5 years)

sources.title: European Commission EU Immigration Portal -- Latvia employed-worker permit: EUR 1,143/month salary floor (2021 figure, reviewed annually), labour market test via the State Employment Agency (NVA), work rights tied to a specific employer and position with no changes allowed

LV Portals (Latvijas Vestnesis, the official state gazette's legal-affairs portal) -- Latvia's New Immigration Law (effective 11 June 2026): employment permit duration reduced from 5 years to 1 year; stricter employer eligibility (denies permits where the employer is an inactive taxpayer, established within the last 6 months, or has tax-compliance violations)

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Latvia). STATUS: DRAFT -- the salary figure is stale (a 2021 baseline the source itself says is 'reviewed each year'; a 2025 figure of EUR 1,757 average salary appears in a separate tier-3 blog but was not independently re-verified against a tier-1/2 page in this pass) and the labour-market-test figures come only from the EC's EU Immigration Portal (tier-2), not an independently fetched PMLP or NVA page. The 1-year duration figure reflects Latvia's brand-new Immigration Law, effective 11 June 2026 (under 3 months before this build) -- this is a LIVE DISCREPANCY worth flagging prominently: PMLP's own English-language duration page (https://www.pmlp.gov.lv/en/how-long-may-residence-permit-be-issued), fetched directly in this same pass, still describes the OLD 5-year employment-permit duration and has evidently not been updated to reflect the new law -- disclosed as an unresolved gap between Latvia's own official page and its own recently passed legislation, not silently resolved by picking one.
